response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT k, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share, (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS avgcnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avgcnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avgcnt
